technical_and_design_decisions: Develop the GemFire Message Channel Binder using Spring Integration GemFire and Apache Geode Client APIs, utilizing Continuous Queries (CQ) or Region Subscriptions for inbound channel adapters and Region operations for outbound channel adapters.
Implement the Spring Cloud Data SPI on top of GemFire to allow orchestrating data microservices using GemFire as the underlying cluster and coordination mechanism.
Implement Stream Repository and Module Registry abstractions using persistent GemFire Regions with custom domain models and JSON/Kryo serialization.
Extend the Stream DSL parser and Shell in Spring Cloud Data Flow / Spring Cloud Data to support the `tap:` syntax for forking stream data sources.
Integrate wire tap / destination binding routing in the stream runtime to publish stream events to tap destinations without impacting primary throughput.
assumptions: Development environment has access to a running Pivotal GemFire / Apache Geode cluster or embedded instance for unit and integration testing.
The codebase aligns with early Spring Cloud Stream / Spring Cloud Data Flow architectures (Java 8+ / Spring Framework 4.3+/5.x).
A single senior software developer with Spring ecosystem expertise will carry out all specification, design, development, documentation, and testing tasks.

activities.activity_description: Analyze requirements for GemFire binder, SPI, repositories, and tapping mechanisms. Define component interfaces, DSL syntax extensions, and GemFire region schemas.
Develop Spring Cloud Stream GemFire binder (U1), including inbound/outbound channel adapters, consumer group partitioning, auto-configuration, and properties.
Implement GemFire SPI for orchestration of data microservices (U2), enabling microservice lifecycle management and state synchronization via GemFire.

activities.activity_name: GemFire Stream Repository and Module Registry
activities.activity_description: Implement GemFire-backed implementations of StreamDefinitionRepository (U3) and ModuleRegistry (U4) using persistent GemFire regions.
Implement stream wire-tapping logic in the core stream launcher and binder integration to allow tapping into primary stream channels (U7).

activities.activity_name: DSL Parser and Shell Integration for Tapping
activities.activity_description: Extend SCDF/SCD DSL grammar, AST parser, and Shell commands to recognize `tap:` syntax and manage tap stream lifecycles (U8).
Create reference documentation for deployment manifests with partition configurations (U5), direct binding usage examples (U6), and GemFire pipeline setups.
Perform comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end testing across GemFire binder, SPI, registries, and DSL tapping scenarios.
